description.text: Why choose to study this program? As one of the national key subjects, the Mechanical Manufacture and Automation focuses on multi-disciplinary, dedicates to the development the application of advanced manufacturing in the information industry, environmental engineering, life sciences and other fields. Please contact us before application to confirm whether this English-medium program would be open this year. Course Arrangement 1. It includes 6 Second Class Disciplines of mechanical manufacturing and automation, mechatronic engineering, mechanical design and theory, vehicle engineering, precision manufacturing engineering, and industrial engineering. 2. It integrates the information science and traditional mechanical manufacturing, and emphasizes on the knowledgeable, digital, integration, network, so as to realize the ascension from the traditional mechanical manufacturing to advanced manufacturing. 3. It takes manufacturing science as the core, automation and precision as support, digital equipment, vehicle engineering, and information industry as carrier to develop the application of advanced manufacturing in information industry, environment engineering and life science. It achieves the “big manufacturers” in the ever-expanding multi-disciplinary and cross-disciplinary extension of mechanical engineering. Diploma Awarded Master's Degree Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the master thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the degree. Entry Requirements Applicants for Master’s degree must have obtained Bachelor’s Degree and be under the age of 35.

duration.text: The Mechanical Manufacture and Automation at Harbin Engineering University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5069 USD/per year ￥ 36500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens, in good health. 2.A Bachelor Degree in related courses. 3.TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (naive speakers needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate).
